name: sparse_join
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM s2.probes p JOIN s2.boxes b ON b.b && p.q

name: medium_join
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM s2.probes WHERE id<=64) p JOIN s2.boxes b ON b.b && box(center(p.q),center(p.q)+point(20,20))

name: absent_join
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM s2.probes p JOIN s2.boxes b ON b.b && box(point(2000+p.id,2000),point(2000+p.id,2000))

name: single_sparse
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM s2.boxes WHERE b && box(point(100,100),point(105,105))

name: allmatch_natural
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM s2.boxes WHERE b && box(point(-1,-1),point(2000,2000))

name: allmatch_forced
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM s2.boxes WHERE b && box(point(-1,-1),point(2000,2000))

name: saturated_natural
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM s2.saturated WHERE b && '((0,0),(0,0))'::box

name: saturated_forced
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM s2.saturated WHERE b && '((0,0),(0,0))'::box

name: tiny_natural
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM s2.probes p JOIN s2.tiny b ON b.b && p.q

name: tiny_forced
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM s2.probes p JOIN s2.tiny b ON b.b && p.q

name: point_off
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM s2.probes p JOIN s2.points b ON b.p <@ p.q

name: knn_off
sql: SELECT sum(id) FROM (SELECT id FROM s2.points ORDER BY p <-> point(101,101) LIMIT 1000)s

name: custom_fn_off
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM s2.probes p JOIN s2.wrapped b ON b.b && p.q

name: two_keys_off
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM s2.probes p JOIN s2.boxes b ON b.b && p.q AND b.b && box(center(p.q)-point(1,1),center(p.q)+point(1,1))

name: null_off
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM s2.boxes WHERE b IS NULL
